observation: Front: the same sphere on a disc that drafts the other way -- widest at the bed, which is the Anti-Sol cue -- and the hoop's edge-on tab at the top. Top: hoop as a single upright line through the globe, mirrored about the piece axis against the Sol piece. Iso: the hoop leans toward -X, the exact mirror of the Sol piece. The sphere is unbroken everywhere; no marking, no seam, no patch. No missing or extra parts, no visible intersection, no floating geometry.
